title: Aloe barbadensis tincture for medicinal use
intro: Aloe barbadensis tincture is a concentrated liquid extract derived from the gel-like pulp of the Aloe vera plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its soothing and healing properties. The tincture is typically prepared by soaking the Aloe gel in alcohol to extract its active compounds. In medicinal applications, it is used to treat skin irritations, burns, and digestive issues. Herbalists often recommend it for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
